FROM fact_oilseeds_sunflower AS T1
JOIN dim_year AS T2 ON T1.year_id = T2.year_id
JOIN dim_geography AS T3 ON T1.geography_id = T3.geography_id
WHERE T2.year = 1970 AND T1.sunflower_production_1000tons > 0
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM fact_oilseeds_sunflower AS T4
    JOIN dim_year AS T5 ON T4.year_id = T5.year_id

    AND T4.geography_id = T1.geography_id
